title: Agentic Engineering Loop
summary: An MCP server and agent toolkit that turns Figma specs into token-wired React scaffolding, cutting feature development time by 40 %.

body.context: Developers spent about 10 hours per component or view translating Figma specs by hand and wiring tokens into boilerplate React.
body.contribution: Designed and built an agentic engineering loop: a Model Context Protocol server plus an agent toolkit that reads design context, injects tokens, and scaffolds components against the design system.
body.outcome: Average scaffolding and token wiring dropped from 10 hours to 6 per component or view across sprint tasks.
